description.narrative: The main goal of this Partner Identification project is to analyze the feasibility of establishing a sustainable long-term project between DSU and the Young Socialists of Georgia (YSG). We are planning on travelling to Tbilisi, Georgia and meet up with the leadership of our Georgian sister organisation the Young Socialists of Georgia. DSU and YSG are both social democratic youth parties and are members of the same European and Global umbrella organisations: The Young European Socialists and the International Union of Socialist Youth. DSU is an older and significantly larger organization, but we share common values and especially an interest in youth workers rights. We expect that this trip will give us the opportunity to learn about each other's organizations, establish a dialogue, and evaluate the different strengths and challenges we face in our work. We expect that this will allow us to determine whether a potential partnership could be feasible and mutually beneficial for our two organizations.
